title: Register of an argument segment
statement: Let a call specification have an ordered list of argument registers, and suppose there is at least one register. For an index $s$ with $0<s\le$ the length of that list, the register assigned to segment $s$ is the argument register at zero-based position $s-1$.
hypotheses_covered: A call specification with an ordered argument-register list
The number of registers $m$ is positive
An index $s$ with $0<s\le$ the length of the argument list
